title: 第三章 柳暗花明第四章 根骨丙下
slug: 武道每日加点打更人肝成人间武圣
content_zh:
“嗯，以后不和他们来往了。”秦苏说道。
吴慕秋看着秦苏故作镇定的模样，有些心疼，说道：“你真有难处就跟我说，我和我爹一定会帮你的。”
秦苏点头谢过她，转身走到炕边，拿出身上钱袋，吴慕秋也跟着进来。
钱袋里面只有三百文铜钱。
这个月要给青石帮帮主老爹大寿上礼，最少一百文。
剩下的二百文，一百文要买几斗糙米，省着吃能吃十几天。
打更的梆子侧边裂了个缝，再敲几次怕是要断，换个新的要二十文。
账算到最后，只剩下八十文，这点钱什么都干不了。
他坐在炕沿上，脑子里飞速过着能走的路。
再去归一武馆求，没三两束脩根本进不去。
白天找其他活计，当挑夫累身还耽误打更，这是爹留的唯一活路，不能耽误打更。
给青石帮做事更是自入虎穴。
闹到县衙，官府只当家事，反倒会落个不孝名声丢了差事。
一条一条的路想出来，又一条一条被他自己否了。
秦苏坐在床边，眉头紧锁，全然没有刚刚的强势。
吴慕秋在一旁静静地站着，她也不知道怎么安慰眼前的这个男人。
沉默半晌，吴慕秋突然想起出门前她爹告诉她的事儿，此刻竟然忘记了。
她赶紧问秦苏，“你，想不想习武？”
这话一出，秦苏猛地抬头，几乎是脱口而出：“想！”
吴慕秋见秦苏反应这么强烈，心中一喜，急忙把老爹交代的事情和秦苏说。

吴慕秋的父亲吴山，常年给内城的商户送粮送菜。
最近新接了个东家，是刚搬到安陆县内城的林老爷。
林老爷是做绸缎生意的，在内城买了宅子，可到底是刚搬进来，跟安陆县本地的家族比不了。
这个世界，不管是做生意还是守家业，手里必须有武者。
可以不用，但不能没有。
林老爷不是没想过招现成的武者，可本事好的，要么早就被本地的大家族养着了。
要么就是要价太高，林家刚立足，掏不起那个钱，也不放心。
算来算去，不如自己养。
找几个身家清白肯吃苦的小子，只要测出有根骨，就资助他们进武馆学武，束脩林家出，每个月还额外给点月钱补身子。
唯一的条件，就是学成之后，要给林家效力五年，五年期满，去留随意。
这样算下来，就比招现成的武者划算，还能养出自己人。
“我爹前几天给林老爷送白菜，在外面等着的时候，听见林老爷跟管家说的这事。”
吴慕秋说，“管家说，已经跟归一武馆的师傅说好了，后天上午，在林家测根骨。
我爹回来就跟我说了，让我问问你，就赶紧过来找你。”
她顿了顿，“就是有一条，得先测根骨。有根骨才能进，没根骨，林老爷也不会白花钱。我也不知道你有没有……”
“我去。”
吴慕秋的话还没说完，秦苏就开口。
这是他唯一的机会，不能放弃。
吴慕秋见秦苏答应了，眼睛也亮了起来，要是秦苏能够习武入门的话，她是秦苏的未婚妻，自然也能有好处。
“好，那后天一早你来我家，你穿得干净一点，到了林家别乱说话，跟着我爹就行。”

秦苏点了点头，心中悬着的石头终于放下，他看向吴慕秋，满是感激。
刚才还觉得前途一片黑暗，现在吴慕秋却给了他一条生路。
秦苏把那三百文铜钱收好，看向吴慕秋，“今天真是谢谢你，要是没有你，我都不知道该怎么办。”
content_en:
"Well, I won't interact with them anymore." Qin Su said.
Seeing Qin Su pretending to be calm, Wu Muchiu felt a little distressed and said, "If you are really in trouble, just tell me, and my father and I will definitely help you."
Qin Su nodded and thanked her, turned and walked to the kang, took out his money bag, and Wu Muchiu followed him in.
There were only three hundred copper coins in the purse.
This month I want to give a birthday gift to the leader of the Qingshi Gang, at least one hundred coins.
For the remaining 200 Wen, a few bushels of brown rice would be needed for the 100 Wen. If you save money, you can eat it for more than ten days.
There is a crack on the side of the watch banger. If I knock it a few more times, it will break. Replacing it with a new one will cost twenty cents.
At the end of the calculation, only eighty cents were left, and nothing could be done with this little money.
He sat on the edge of the kang, his mind racing through the possible paths he could take.
I went to Guiyi Martial Arts Hall again to ask for help, but I couldn’t get in without three ounces of Xiuxiu.
Looking for other jobs during the day, working as a porter was too tiring and delayed the watch. This was the only way for my father to make a living, and he couldn't delay the watch.
Working for the Qingshi Gang is even more dangerous.
If the trouble comes to the county government, the government will only take care of family affairs, but it will get a reputation of being unfilial and lose the job.
He figured out one way after another, but he rejected each one one by one.
Qin Su sat beside the bed, his brows furrowed, not as strong as before.
Wu Muchiu stood quietly aside, and she didn't know how to comfort the man in front of her.
After being silent for a long time, Wu Muchiu suddenly remembered what her father told her before going out, but she had forgotten it at this moment.
She quickly asked Qin Su, "Do you want to practice martial arts?"
As soon as these words came out, Qin Su suddenly raised his head and almost blurted out: "Think!"
Seeing Qin Su's strong reaction, Wu Muchiu felt happy and hurriedly told Qin Su what her father had told her.
Wu Muchiu's father, Wu Shan, delivers food and vegetables to merchants in the inner city all year round.
Recently I took over a new owner, Mr. Lin, who just moved to the inner city of Anlu County.
Mr. Lin is in the silk and satin business and bought a house in the inner city. However, he has just moved in and cannot compare with the local families in Anlu County.
In this world, whether you are doing business or taking care of your family business, you must have warriors on your hands.
You can use it, but you can’t live without it.
It's not that Mr. Lin has never thought of recruiting ready-made warriors, but those with good skills have either been taken care of by the local big families.
Either the asking price is too high, and the Lin family has just established itself, cannot afford the money, and is not at ease.
After all, it's better to raise it yourself.
Find a few boys who are innocent and willing to endure hardships. As long as they are found to have a bone, they will be subsidized to enter the martial arts hall to learn martial arts, and they will be paid by Xiulin's family. They will also be given some extra monthly money to replenish their health.
The only condition is that after completing the studies, you must serve the Lin family for five years. After the five years, you can stay or leave as you please.
Calculating this way, it is more cost-effective than recruiting ready-made warriors, and you can also raise your own people.
"My father sent cabbage to Mr. Lin a few days ago. While waiting outside, he heard Mr. Lin talking to the housekeeper about this."
Wu Muchiu said, "The housekeeper said that he has made an agreement with the master of Guiyi Martial Arts School to have his bones measured at Lin's house the day after tomorrow.
My father told me when he came back and asked me to ask you, so he came to find you quickly. "
She paused, "Even if there is one, the bone must be measured first. Only if there is a bone can it be entered. If there is no bone, Mr. Lin will not spend money in vain. I don't know if you have..."
"I'll go."
Before Wu Muchiu finished speaking, Qin Su spoke.
This is his only chance and he can't give it up.
Wu Muchiu's eyes lit up when she saw Qin Su agreed. If Qin Su could learn martial arts, she would be Qin Su's fiancée, so she would naturally benefit from it.
"Okay, then you come to my house early the day after tomorrow. Dress cleanly. Don't talk nonsense when you get to the Lin family. Just follow my father."
Qin Su nodded, and the stone hanging in his heart was finally put down. He looked at Wu Muchiu, full of gratitude.
Just now he thought his future was dark, but now Wu Muchiu gave him a way out.
Qin Su put away the three hundred copper coins and looked at Wu Muchiu, "Today is really...Thank you, I don’t know what I would do without you. "
